notes: Both named handles (@AmericanExpress, @AmexBusiness) returned HTTP 404 from yt-dlp, so channel listings could not be produced; official partner-facing videos instead surfaced on regional channels (American Express UK, American Express Australia, AmericanExpressCAD). No official video of developer.americanexpress.com, a sandbox, AMEX Enabled certification, or the GNS Knowledge Base was found; the developer portal is a JS shell to fetch and the Knowledge Base 302s to the enterprise login. US merchant pages under /us/merchant/ for Knowledge Base, Online Merchant Account and AMEX Enabled returned 404 at the guessed URLs. The session's WebSearch quota was exhausted before this run, so vimeo, SlideShare, Speaker Deck, app-store, conference-archive and court-exhibit searches did not execute; those remain gaps. Amex Merchant App store listings (iOS/Android) are implied by the UK/AU videos but not fetched. Per-video metadata required alternate player clients (android,ios) to avoid YouTube's reload block.
